correctness.rationale: Five explicit algebraic steps establish quandle product as f(T^-1)g(T^2), prove nonzero augmentation-zero idempotents impossible, give finite log/exp bijections in K[u]/u^p, solve each coefficient (-1)^m+2^m-1, and derive exact K^kappa product law. Direct exhaustive q3, q5, q9 calculations, ten prime laws, and the nontrivial p17 witness passed the standalone checker. The F9 3-support witness was separately confirmed through explicit square-coordinate identities. Universal claim rests on proof, not finite checks.

value.rationale: The family of nonassociative quandle algebras is natural; all idempotents and their multiplication form a complete invariant uniformly in p and coefficient extension. The exact ord_p(2) resonance controls the first prime-field jump p17 and a three-dimensional case p31. An explicit F9 example materially sharpens a published positive-characteristic claim about length-three idempotents. These structural and boundary results are not merely routine reparameterizations or isolated small computations.
